Hi,
I came across your Shopify app and noticed it's still early in its launch phase and building its initial merchant traction.
I'm a Shopify Partner and e-commerce specialist. I manage a network of active Shopify stores and work directly with live store owners. I can connect your app with real merchants who will install, test, and use it in active Shopify environments, providing direct user feedback and genuine merchant reviews based on their experience.
Running Shopify App Store ads can burn budget fast and without solid social proof, ad traffic rarely converts because merchants hesitate to install unproven apps. Building organic merchant usage and verified reviews gives you a far higher ROI than paid ads: it boosts your long-term search ranking, drives sustainable organic installs, and helps you qualify for the Built for Shopify badge.
To be completely clear, this is 100% genuine store activity no bots, fake accounts, or fabricated reviews.
If you're looking to build sustainable traction and push toward that Built for Shopify status without wasting money on ads, I can share how we structure the process and pricing.
Are you open to a quick discussion on this?
